project_type: Next.js 15 frontend + Express.js backend, PostgreSQL DB, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript frontend / CommonJS backend

test_framework: Jest (backend only, npm test in backend/). No frontend test framework configured.
verification_instructions: 1. For frontend changes: run 'cd c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\frontend && npm run build' and confirm zero TypeScript errors. 2. For backend changes: run 'cd c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\backend && npm test'. 3. For visual/UI changes: run 'npm run dev' in both directories and test in browser at http://localhost:3000.

contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns. Use CommonJS require() in backend, ES module imports in frontend. Match existing error response shape: { success: false, error: { code, message } }.
key_patterns: 1. Backend routes use express router, query() from ../db for all DB access, structured JSON error responses. 2. Frontend pages are 'use client' components using useState/useEffect. 3. i18n uses t('key') from '@/i18n' (index.ts) in most pages. 4. Onboarding still uses lib/i18n.ts (LangCode type, LANGUAGES with ttsLocale). 5. localStorage keys: arthsathi_lang (switcher+index), as_lang (lib/i18n — INCONSISTENT), as_user_id (user auth), as_profile. 6. API URL resolved via frontend/lib/config.ts getApiUrl(). 7. Emoji icons in JSX are plain string literals like '📍' or '🌱'.
directory_structure: ArthSathiFinal/ — root. backend/ — Express server (server.js entry), src/routes/ (all route files), src/services/ (profileService, roadmapService, ocrService, engineService), src/db.js (pg pool). frontend/ — Next.js app, app/ (route pages), components/ (ui/ subdirectory), i18n/ (translation files + index.ts), lib/ (config.ts, i18n.ts). .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts.
